_comment.fiction: Demonstration only: Mike Malon is fictional, including his NYU degree, dates and projects. Replace every claim with the real candidate's reviewed evidence.
_comment.identity: display_name is for letter signing; headline_name is the resume header; email must match the application profile.
_comment.graduation_school: Institution for the current degree. Keep it consistent with education and the resume.
_comment.expected_graduation_date: Reviewed month and year used by tailoring; this example is May 2028, not a real candidate fact.
_comment.tailored_summaries: Reviewed prose by role family; default is the fallback. The generator is hardware-oriented, so review its output for CS roles.
_comment.candidate_summary: Supported introduction used in generated cover letters. Remove fictional project claims before real use.
_comment.closing_strength: Evidence-backed closing sentence; do not invent outcomes or proficiency.
_comment.evidence_groups: Each unique name has match keywords and one verifiable evidence statement. Keywords match jobs; they are not proof of expertise.
_comment.education_gpa: Map institution to verified GPA display; leave empty when unknown.
_comment.graduation_confirmation: Record school, integer month/year, confirmed_on and source only after candidate confirmation.
